n01.text:
1 Idle
Page: --ts-bg
Header label: --ts-text-muted, --ts-type-secondary
Health dot: --ts-health-ok, 16px, aria-label
Video zone: --ts-surface, 390 by 219
Use demo hike: --ts-accent fill, --ts-text, --ts-type-label, 64px
Load video: --ts-surface-2, 3px --ts-text-muted border
Event log header: --ts-text, --ts-divider rule, 64px
Status: --ts-type-hero 56px, --ts-text
Mic idle: --ts-surface-2 fill, --ts-accent-bright ring, 112px
Pills off: --ts-surface-2, --ts-text-muted border

n02.text:
2 Playing, trail clear
Video: trail footage placeholder on --ts-surface, progress track --ts-surface-2, fill --ts-accent-bright, times --ts-type-meta 18px
Last warning: --ts-type-hero 56px in --ts-text-muted (spoken, now stale)
Trail clear line: --ts-type-label 24px, --ts-accent-bright, check glyph
Event log count: --ts-text-muted
Everything else as frame 1

n03.text:
3 Severity 1 note
Status zone fill: --ts-sev-1-bg #9ED8AE
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, --ts-sev-1-fg
Severity word and glyph: --ts-type-label 24px, check glyph, --ts-sev-1-fg
Event log header shows 1 new, --ts-accent-bright badge
All chrome unchanged

n04.text:
4 Severity 2 caution
Status zone fill: --ts-sev-2-bg #E0A526
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, --ts-sev-2-fg
Caution word and triangle glyph: --ts-type-label, --ts-sev-2-fg
Log count rises to 2
Greyscale: this zone reads mid grey, darker than note, lighter than stop

n05.text:
5 Severity 3 stop
Status zone fill: --ts-sev-3-bg #8F0F19, entire zone, no padding gaps
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, --ts-sev-3-fg pure white, 9.3:1
STOP glyph: 64px octagon beside the text, --ts-sev-3-fg
Stop word: --ts-type-label 24px
The only frame where the hero fill touches both edges, so it reads at two metres
Log count 3

n06.text:
6 Fork with sign
Status zone fill: --ts-fork-bg #8DC4F5, text --ts-fork-fg
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, Fork word and fork glyph at --ts-type-label
Sign card: --ts-bg fill inside the blue zone, --ts-radius-control 16px
Arrow tile: --ts-fork-bg on --ts-fork-fg, 64px
Lynn Loop: --ts-type-heading 32px, --ts-text
2.1 km: --ts-type-label 24px, --ts-text-muted
Spoken line: --ts-type-secondary 20px, --ts-fork-fg

n07.text:
7 Agent listening
Mic listening: --ts-accent fill, --ts-accent-bright ring plus one outer pulse (off under reduced motion)
Status: last warning stays, --ts-text-muted
Transcript line: --ts-type-label 24px, --ts-text, mic glyph --ts-accent-bright, aria-live polite
Mic aria-label: Listening, tap to stop

n08.text:
8 Agent speaking
Mic speaking: --ts-text fill, --ts-bg waveform glyph, no motion
Transcript: --ts-type-label 24px, --ts-text, two sentences, speaker glyph --ts-accent-bright
Last warning: --ts-type-hero at 40px minimum, --ts-text-muted, to give the answer room
Mic aria-label: TrailSense is speaking, tap to interrupt

n09.text:
9 Event log expanded
Log header: aria-expanded true, chevron up, --ts-text
Rows: 44px, --ts-surface, --ts-divider between
Swatch: 40px left edge, --ts-sev-1-bg, --ts-sev-2-bg, --ts-sev-3-bg, --ts-fork-bg, each with its glyph
Timestamp: --ts-type-meta 18px tabular, --ts-text-muted
Say text: --ts-type-secondary 20px, --ts-text
Sign lines: 18px --ts-text-muted
The status zone is hidden while the log is open; the newest row is the status

n10.text:
10 Live mode
Video zone: camera preview placeholder on --ts-surface
Analysing chip: --ts-bg fill, --ts-divider border, blinking dot --ts-accent-bright (static under reduced motion), 18px
Live pill on: --ts-accent fill, --ts-text, check glyph, aria-checked true
Status zone fill: --ts-accent, hero --ts-text, Trail clear with check glyph
Health dot: --ts-health-ok

n11.text:
11 Backend offline
Health dot: --ts-health-fail, aria-label Backend offline
Banner: --ts-surface-2 fill, 3px --ts-text-muted border, --ts-health-fail dot, --ts-type-secondary 20px, role status
Status: last warning, --ts-text-muted
Mic idle; voice agent unavailable so the mic aria-label says so

n12.text:
12 Session QR
Idle state plus a share tile in the lower right of the status zone
QR tile: --ts-text fill, modules in #000000 (QR needs true black on light), 96px
Share this hike: --ts-accent-bright link, 18px, underlined
Tile is one link with aria-label Share this hike, opens the share page
Sized to stay 16px off both edges and 24px above the bottom bar

s01.text:
S1 Fall check-in started
Screen: #000000 ground, --ts-sos-bg #FFD60A for everything drawn, 14.9:1
Whole screen is one button, aria-label Cancel the fall check-in, inside role alertdialog
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, Are you okay? Say anything to cancel.
Ring: 240px; track is a 4px #FFD60A hairline, progress arc is 20px #FFD60A, round caps, starts at 12 o'clock and drains clockwise
Number: 120px, weight 700, tabular, aria-live assertive, spoken every 5 s
Instruction: --ts-type-label 24px, pinned 40px above the bottom edge
Motion: arc eases 1 s per tick; under reduced motion it steps

s02.text:
S2 Check-in cancelled
Status zone fill: --ts-sev-1-bg #9ED8AE, text --ts-sev-1-fg
Hero: --ts-type-hero 56px, Cancelled. Help is not being called.
Check glyph plus the word Cancelled at --ts-type-label
Normal chrome returns around it: header, video, log header, bottom bar
Fade: zone opacity 1 to 0 over 400 ms after 3 s, then the muted last warning returns; under reduced motion it cuts
role status, polite, so it does not interrupt the spoken confirmation

s03.text:
S3 SOS sent
Top banner: --ts-sev-3-bg #8F0F19, --ts-sev-3-fg white, role alert, persistent, two rows
Banner line: --ts-type-label 24px, Help contacted at 2:14 pm, with the alert glyph
Cancel SOS: 64px, --ts-surface-2 fill, 3px --ts-text-muted border, --ts-text label, aria-label Cancel SOS, confirms with a second tap; deliberately not --ts-accent and not yellow
Status zone: #000000 fill, --ts-sos-bg hero Calling for help now. at 56px with the SOS glyph
Health dot stays --ts-health-ok; mic is idle

s04.text:
LV4 Guidance, trail clear
Screen: #000000, #FFD60A only, nothing else drawn
Arrow: thin, stroke 16px, round caps and joins, SVG viewBox 390 by 844
Shaft: x 195, from y 560 (66% of height, the lower third) up to y 300 (36%), length 260px
Head: polyline 135,360 to 195,300 to 255,360, 120px wide, 60px tall
Text: 64px, weight 700, --ts-sos-bg, centred, top at y 600
Low vision pill: bottom, 64 by 220, #000000 fill, 3px #FFD60A border, #FFD60A text and check, aria-checked true

s05.text:
LV5 Guidance, hazard left
Arrow: thick, stroke 40px, round caps and joins, points right, away from the hazard
Shaft: y 400, from x 60 to x 330 (70% of width)
Head: polyline 250,320 to 330,400 to 250,480, 160px tall
Text: Drop-off, left at 64px, two lines allowed, top at y 560
The arrow is 2.5 times the stroke of the clear arrow, so weight alone says hazard
Pill as LV4

s06.text:
LV6 Stop
Octagon: filled #FFD60A, no stroke, 358px across (full width inside 16px gutters), centred in the top two thirds (y 16 to 562)
Points at 105,0 253,0 358,105 358,253 253,358 105,358 0,253 0,105 in a 358 box, corner cut 105px (0.293 of the side)
Text: Stop at 64px, top at y 620
Only the Low vision pill remains so the mode can be turned off; it is 24px above the bottom edge
role img aria-label Stop on the glyph; the text is aria-live assertive

share-title.text: Live share page for the emergency contact, light theme

sh01.text:
Share, phone, normal
Light tokens: --ts-light-bg #F4F6F2, --ts-light-surface #FFFFFF, --ts-light-text #0B1410, --ts-light-muted #44534A (7.5:1), --ts-light-divider #D5DDD6
Map: --ts-map-ground #E6EAE4, contours --ts-light-divider, track --ts-accent 5px, pin --ts-accent with white ring, pulse ring --ts-accent at 50% (static under reduced motion)
Header: 20px bold, session id mono 16px muted, Last update with --ts-accent dot, role status
Events card: --ts-light-surface, 44px rows, 16px timestamps, 12px severity dot plus the severity word in the sentence, 18px text
Call hiker: tel link, 72px, --ts-accent fill, white 26px

sh02.text:
Share, phone, SOS
Banner: --ts-sev-3-bg #8F0F19, white 18px bold, role alert, 64px, above the header, only when sos_sent exists in the session
Status dot turns --ts-sev-3-bg
Newest event row is the SOS, bold
Map and Call hiker unchanged; the map shrinks by the banner height

sh03.text:
Share, laptop, normal
1280 by 800, fluid page: map flex 999 1 560px, aside 360 to 400px, wraps under the map below 960px
Header on --ts-light-surface with a divider, 24px title, mono session id
Map 6px track, 12px pin
Events card rows 56px; Call hiker 88px, 30px label
Same tokens as the phone frame

sh04.text:
Share, laptop, SOS
Banner centred, 22px bold on --ts-sev-3-bg, role alert, persists until the session ends
Everything else as the normal laptop frame

s07.text:
LV7 Fork
Stem: stroke 24px, x 195, from y 600 up to y 430
Left branch: stroke 12px, 195,430 to 95,290 (the way not to go)
Right branch: stroke 40px, 195,430 to 295,290, with an arrowhead polyline 230,290 to 295,290 to 295,355 (65px legs)
Highlight is weight plus the arrowhead, never a second colour
Text: Fork ahead, right at 64px, two lines allowed, top at y 630
Pill as LV4
